title: Every coherent sheaf on a Noetherian algebraic space is filtered with subquotients pushed forward from ideal sheaves on irreducible supports
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Algebraic Spaces)

difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a filtration of any coherent sheaf on a Noetherian algebraic space whose successive subquotients are pushforwards of ideal sheaves from reduced irreducible closed subspaces (statement lines 2520-2536). The proof runs the usual minimal counterexample argument on the support: a reducible support is split into two smaller pieces, the general irreducible case is reduced by filtering along the powers of the ideal of the support, and the remaining case is handled by a preparation lemma that exhibits the sheaf as an extension of a pushed forward ideal power and a sheaf supported in a proper closed subset. The minimal counterexample reduction and the final extension step are the substance, so the claim is H2.
